name: OSTP
full_name: Office of Science and Technology Policy
rd_focus: Doesn't fund R&D directly; coordinates federal priorities through the National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) and advises POTUS via PCAST.
applications: Cross-cutting AI policy — embodied AI, autonomous systems, safety, workforce — sets agency priorities downstream at NSF / DOE / NIST / NASA.
manufacturing: Indirect — shapes CHIPS Act implementation priorities and Manufacturing USA emphases.
programs: Winning the AI Race: America's AI Action Plan (July 2025) — 90+ recs across Innovation / Infrastructure / Diplomacy pillars.
Director Michael Kratsios (confirmed Mar 2025); Lynne Parker as Counselor + PCAST exec director.
Public statements emphasize NIST AI RMF as the federal procurement baseline.

name: DOE
rd_focus: National-lab robotics + AI-driven materials and manufacturing. ORNL, Argonne, Sandia, INL all run robotics + self-driving-lab programs.
applications: Grid inspection, nuclear fuel-cycle handling, AI-enabled defense manufacturing.
manufacturing: EERE Advanced Manufacturing Office; ARM Institute (Manufacturing USA, robotics-specific).
programs: Genesis Mission — DOE Office of Science, $320M FY26; 14 robotics + automated-lab projects (HPCwire breakdown). Includes OPAL (PNNL — agentic biology design-build-test-learn), ACMAS (autonomous nuclear-materials characterization), SYNAPS-I (LBNL autonomous imaging at neutron/photon facilities).
Exascale Foundry — ORNL + Autonomous Resource Corp, AI-enabled defense manufacturing (May 2026).
National-lab LDRD funds self-driving labs at ORNL / Argonne / LBNL (IFP brief).

name: ARPA-E
rd_focus: High-risk energy R&D; periodic solicitations for embodied AI / robotics applied to energy systems.
applications: Robot-driven grid maintenance, fuel-cycle automation, autonomous wind/solar O&M.
manufacturing: Adjacent — manufacturing tooling shows up in some open program-area awards.
programs: Embodied AI for Energy Systems open call; typical award $1–10M.
FY 2026 request ≈ $478M total; up to 4 new focused solicitations in FY26.

name: DOC
rd_focus: Industrial policy + standards rather than direct R&D.
applications: Semiconductor fab automation; regional robotics clusters via Tech Hubs.
manufacturing: Central — administers CHIPS funding and designates Regional Tech Hubs.
programs: EDA Regional Tech Hubs — Phase 2 designation includes robotics-anchored clusters.

name: NIST
full_name: National Institute of Standards and Technology
rd_focus: Engineering Lab: Intelligent Systems Division, robotics performance test protocols.
applications: Industrial humanoid performance metrics; safety standards for human-robot shared workspaces.
programs: Humanoid Robot Baseline Performance Benchmark — locomotion + manipulation test protocol; NIST will fabricate and freely distribute apparatuses to U.S. humanoid manufacturers and regional testing facilities; designs published as physical and virtual testbed.
NIST SP 1227 (draft) — performance metrics + test methods for robotic assembly + manipulation.
Standards-setting role; not a direct grant funder.

name: NSF
rd_focus: Foundational + academic robotics research across CISE and Engineering Directorates.
applications: Co-robots, human-robot interaction, integrative systems, agricultural + healthcare robotics.
manufacturing: Through Engineering Directorate and Manufacturing USA partnerships.
programs: Foundational Research in Robotics (FRR) — rolling submissions.
FY26 House mark proposes NSF cuts; AI + quantum prioritized.

name: NASA
rd_focus: JPL robotics — rovers, manipulators, autonomous exploration.
applications: Mars rovers (Perseverance), Astrobee (ISS), CLPS lunar landers.
manufacturing: In-space assembly + manufacturing via COSMIC industry consortium.
programs: OSAM-1 cancelled Feb 2024 after cost growth $0.7B → $2B+.
DARPA RSGS — provides expertise; no longer prime.
FY24 budget ≈ $24.8B total agency.

name: Space Force
rd_focus: Autonomous space systems, on-orbit servicing in partnership with AFRL + DARPA.
applications: Satellite servicing, refueling, dynamic space operations, in-orbit inspection.
manufacturing: Procures; doesn't manufacture. Drives commercial robotic-satellite-service market.
programs: 4 servicing missions launching 2026: DARPA RSGS, Astroscale refueler, Tetra-5 (with AFRL), Otter.
Otter contract — $54.5M to Starfish Space.
FY26 SAML budget ≈ $9.7M (down 66% from $29.2M).

name: DARPA
rd_focus: High-risk autonomy research; technology-transition to services + commercial primes.
applications: Autonomous aerial / ground / maritime systems; satellite servicing.
manufacturing: Funds prototype manufacturing through cooperative agreements.
programs: RSGS — Mission Robotic Vehicle launches 2026 via Space Logistics; NRL-built arm.

name: USDA
rd_focus: Agricultural robotics + autonomous farm systems. Co-funder of NSF NRI 3.0.
applications: Harvesting, livestock management, soil/crop sensing, autonomous tractors.
programs: AI Institutes — Ag track: AgAID (workforce + specialty crops) and AIFARMS (livestock + soil) — co-funded with NSF.
NIFA × NSF agricultural-robotics partnership.
AFRI Foundational A1541 (next cycle opens late summer 2026).

name: NIH
rd_focus: Surgical, rehabilitation, and assistive robotics across NIBIB, NCI, NICHD, NINDS.
applications: Robotic surgery, prosthetics, in-home elder care, telerehab.
programs: NRI 3.0 co-funder (health + assistive track).
NIBIB Bioengineering Research Grants and SBIR/STTR include robotics topics.

name: DOT
rd_focus: Autonomous-vehicle safety research; freight automation; UAS integration.
applications: On-road AVs, autonomous freight rail, commercial UAS, urban air mobility.
programs: NRI 3.0 co-funder (AV-safety track).
NHTSA AV oversight; FAA UAS integration office.

name: PA DCED
full_name: Pennsylvania Department of Community & Economic Development
